text: TO:
Dr. Seligman
FROM:
C. V. Mace
DATE: November 19, 1964
SUBJECT:
Information required from Managers to develop
the plans and timetable for the three cigarette
development programs
I. As to a P. M. Multifilter modification with substantially
1mproved mucus flow and incorporating polyox in the filter,
I need to know by November 25th:
A. Confirmation at AME of the mucus flow results on fused
polyox carbon plus CA (12.5 mm PC - 7.5 mm CA, dual
G4PW
plug) with MFz blend.
B。
Preliminary estimate of the cost of fused polyox
carbon plus CA plug (alternative one) and of polyox
carbon on tow plus CA (alternative two) both versus
MF2 plug
C.
Estimate of time required to get alternatives one and
two to the commercial production stage taking into
account when the polyox will be available in the form
desired.
II.
As to a revised MF product with low TPM (10 mg), high
nicotine, superior pulmonary clearance, and a low
carcinogenic index, I need to know by December 9th:
A. Confirmation at AME of the mucus flow results on the
second F prototype using the 10% Maryland blend
and confirmation of the results for fused polyox
E4IT-4
carbon plus CA as requested for cigarette development
program I.
B。
Estimate of the number of blend combinations we may
have to evaluate and the time it will require to get
low B(a)P and superior pulmonary clearance result
C.
Estimate of when we might have a substance which when
added to the tobacco blend will reduce B(a)P delivery.
D.
Estimate of when the carcinogenic
indices
(Iverson, skin painting, etc. tests) will be ready for
routine use and also how much time will be required for
routinely testing a cigarette sample.
E.
Re-estimate of time required to improve the flavor of
this product so that it at least doesn't lose to
Parliament
